cohort: The study included 11,792 RA pregnancies and 10,413,681 non-RA pregnancies in women whose pregnancies ended in France between 2010 and 2020.
finding: Pregnancies in women with RA were associated with more adverse outcomes, especially if the disease was active.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were significantly higher in women with RA compared to the general population (OR a 1.46) and even higher in women with active RA compared to non-active RA (OR a 1.25).
